purpose: Single full-game completion programme. This replaces the 27-cell starter as the project scope.
rules: Integrate every delivered cell that passes validation; never block unrelated passed cells on a failed/missing cell.
Never substitute reference cards, generic rigs, rejected identity variants, or wrong states as finished art.
Do not bake interchangeable weapons or temporal VFX where the master contract forbids them.
Preserve the 283 already accepted exact registered cells and all existing valid UI/environment/VFX assets.
Record failures in one correction queue and continue forward.
Run native phone/tablet visual review on installed cells and game-wide UI selection/layering/touch regressions.
